standard-dialogue-before-completing-a-ki.npc: What is it, human? Speak and begone, your presence disgusts me!
Stop your muttering and get to the point!
I am the Voice of Yama.
Yama is my master, a powerful demon of fire.

standard-dialogue-before-completing-a-ki.player: Why can't Yama speak for themself?

standard-dialogue-before-completing-a-ki.npc: Currently my master resides below us, building strength. Worry not, human, my master will eventually own your soul too.

standard-dialogue-before-completing-a-ki.text: You must complete A Kingdom Divided to access Yama's domain.

standard-dialogue-first-time.player: Upset that I disrupted your plans?

standard-dialogue-first-time.npc: Disgusting. My master, the great demon Yama, wishes to speak with you.

standard-dialogue-first-time.player: Yama wants to speak with me? How do you know that? You shouldn't even be able to talk to him.

standard-dialogue-first-time.npc: My master wishes to have the satisfaction of explaining that to you himself. For this, I envy him. I will make do with the idiotic expression you wear presently.

standard-dialogue-first-time.player: I planted the device! Your connection should be severed!

standard-dialogue-first-time.npc: Silence, human! You will make no demands of me. Proceed to my master's domain and speak with him yourself if you desire an answer.

steps.text: Player is transported to Yama's Domain.

steps.player: I think I'd rather stay here.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.npc: Proceed or begone, human. I will not bear your foul presence any longer than is necessary.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-enter-th.npc: You may not go where you please without my master's blessing, human. Step back.
